headline: Last session: Sensex rises 414 points and Nifty closes above 23,100 led by IT sector gains

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 19 October.

why: IT stocks led the rally on Friday, driving Indian equity indices higher for a second consecutive session.
Sensex gained over 400 points while Nifty comfortably settled above the 23,100 mark in the previous session.
The Indian government halted sugar diversion for ethanol for 2026-27 as retail sugar prices touched record highs.
Global market sentiment faced headwinds as US crude oil crossed $100 per barrel amid escalating Middle East tensions.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets closed on a positive note on Friday, October 16, with IT stocks leading the overall gains.
Urban Company reported its Q2 financial results, with net loss widening to ₹182.48 crore despite a 41.4% increase in revenue.
US Wall Street indices closed down sharply on Friday due to a chip sell-off, AI growth doubts, and surging oil prices.
Indian equity markets are closed today, October 17, for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, October 19.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed higher for a second straight day, boosted by strong gains in IT stocks.
Meanwhile, global markets faced pressure on Friday as Wall Street dropped and US crude oil prices climbed above $100 per barrel.
Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 19 October.
